final: WITH per_event AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) AS avg_spent, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event) SELECT link_to_event, avg_spent, avg_remaining, avg_remaining - (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) FROM per_event) AS diff_from_mean FROM per_event ORDER BY diff_from_mean DESC IS NULL, diff_from_mean DESC LIMIT 10
